root = Card("expense-review", "Expense Review", review_stack)
review_stack = Stack("review-content", [intro_text, status_filter, expense_table, review_note, approve_button, result_alert])
intro_text = Text("review-instructions", "Review routine operating expenses and approve the pending expense.")
status_filter = Select("status-filter", "Status", "status_filter", ["all", "pending", "approved"], "pending")
expense_table = Table("expense-table", ["expense_id", "merchant", "amount", "status"], [{"expense_id":"exp-001","merchant":"Wide World Courier","amount":"EUR 58.40","status":"pending"},{"expense_id":"exp-002","merchant":"City Print","amount":"EUR 112.00","status":"pending"}])
review_note = Input("review-note", "Reviewer note", "review_note", "")
approve_button = Button("approve-exp-001", "Approve Wide World Courier", {"name":"ApproveExpense","expense_id":"exp-001"})
result_alert = Alert("approval-result", "success", "Expense exp-001 approved.")
